technical.summary: FOX shows strong bullish structure with price above all key MAs and new highs, but extreme overbought RSI conditions and OBV divergence create pullback risk; moderate entry quality with elevated caution warranted.

fundamental.summary: FOX shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signals, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk within 90 days.

sentiment.summary: Weak bearish signal from congressional sales by Ro Khanna (97-98 days old, stale) combined with neutral market sentiment and unavailable news data; insufficient conviction for directional trade.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (186.6) indicates extreme market stress; earnings in 90 days adds moderate event risk but secondary to acute macro deterioration.

debate.key_bull_argument: Strong technical structure with price above all major MAs, supertrend bullish, new 10/20-day highs, and 15x volume spike create textbook momentum setup.
debate.key_bear_argument: Extreme RSI overbought (79.87), OBV divergence, weak ADX (28.47), macro crisis (inverted yield curve, VIX 186.6), zero fundamental support, and no active strategy triggered make this a high-risk fade into resistance.

decision.entry_rationale: Technical setup shows strong momentum structure with price above all MAs and volume spike, but this is a classic overbought fade into macro crisis conditions with zero fundamental support.
decision.primary_risk: Extreme RSI overbought (79.87) combined with inverted yield curve and VIX crisis (186.6) creates severe pullback/crash risk; OBV divergence signals momentum exhaustion.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bearish bias despite technical strength
